name: ST Restore Selector provider-neutral foundation
purpose: Create a deterministic provider-neutral engine invocation plan and convert a trusted Stage 9 recommendation plus provenance-bound Stage 9A preservation evidence into an original-aware controlled selection decision without bypassing safety.

engineCapabilities.rule: Only explicitly approved, available and enabled engines may be planned for invocation.

variantSelectionRequires: recommended variant exists exactly once in Stage 9 variants
Stage 9A source and candidate identities match

outputs.invocationPlan: deterministic list of invoke/skip recommendations with reason codes
outputs.selectionDecision: controlled non-production source-variant decision with reason codes
outputs.selectedArtifactId: original unless all bounded selection requirements pass
outputs.reviewRequired: true on uncertainty or malformed evidence

lockedInvariants: hard deterministic veto cannot be overridden
hard semantic veto cannot be overridden
review-required evidence cannot become automatic variant selection
missing Stage 9A preservation evidence fails safe
selector decision is not teacher approval
selector decision is not OMR or human musical truth
